lines.text: Never answer a doorbell that rings from your bedroom.
3:04 AM. My phone lit up: person detected.
lines.say: Three oh four A.M. My phone lit up: person detected.

lines.text: The front door camera showed an empty porch.
Then it chimed again. Not from the hallway.
It was coming from under my bed.
Every night at 3:04. For eleven months.
lines.say: Every night at three oh four. For eleven months.

lines.text: I moved in ten months ago.
The last chime had a voice message.
A whisper: don't look under the bed.
So never answer a doorbell that rings from your bedroom.
